playing_status: Game running — settings are locked until this session ends.
achievement_empty: No unlocks recorded in this copy yet. Launch from here to record new trophy events.
achievement_error: Local progress could not be read: {error}
achievement_help: Owner-supplied trophy metadata only. Known hidden trophies stay masked until unlocked. Unknown icons are hidden unless you opt in below. Save/PSN progress is not guessed or imported automatically.
achievement_missing: Select your game folder first. No achievement files are created just by opening this page.
audio_builtin: Audio: built-in mixer, experimental (libSceNgs2.sprx not found or not selected).
baseline_hint: 30 FPS is the baseline. 60 FPS and unlocked are experimental; this selector does not enable the complete EU timing/native-1440p developer profile.
busy_settings: Settings are locked while this launcher prepares or runs a game.
prompts_hint: Original code-drawn tutorial/controller-guide images only. Unmatched and geometry-based menu symbols stay unchanged. Auto follows deliberate input, not stick drift. Manual overrides do not change controls. Unknown keyboard names show ?. Custom controller remaps use original diagrams. No game archives are edited.
clear_cache_ask: This deletes the compiled shaders ({size}); the next start takes longer to load and may stutter at first. Continue?
clear_cache_empty: The shader cache is already empty.
clear_cache_failed: {size} freed, but {count} file(s) could not be deleted (in use? Close the game and try again).
crashed: The game closed with an error (code {code}). The log has the details.
credits_detail: Original TLG port: HayatoG and contributors. Code lineage: gow3_pc, bloodborne_pc and shadPS4. ATRAC9: LibAtrac9. Existing GPL and third-party credits retained.
experimental_warning: Experimental EU timing/native-1440p setup is documented on the project page; this UI does not silently enable it.
filters: Image filters (live in the in-game menu too, Insert → Image)
fork_by: Community fork by b3ndoi · original port by HayatoG
fps_hint: 30 FPS is the baseline. 60 FPS and unlocked are experimental; this selector does not enable the complete EU timing/native-1440p developer profile.
identity_unknown: Choose a supported game folder to detect its title and revision.
legal_detail: Not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment, SIE Japan Studio or genDESIGN. No game or firmware files are included. Rights in the game remain with their respective owners.
local_only: Local progress only — not PlayStation Network trophies.
mods_empty: No cheat XML files found in the mods folder yet.
mods_hint: Drop shadPS4/GoldHEN cheat XML files in the mods folder, then turn them on here. Nothing here changes the game until you enable it.
mods_warning: A cheat can crash the game or behave oddly; if that happens, turn it off here.
mouse_hint: Esc releases the mouse; a click in the game window takes it back.
notification_hint: Notifications are off by default. Windows may suppress them; unlocks are still saved. A launcher message is always shown for a new unlock.
quit_running: Close the launcher and stop the game it started?
remap_help: Click Set and press a key or mouse button, or type SDL names (Space, Left Shift, Mouse Left, Mouse X1, Wheel Up…). "|" gives several: Q|Mouse Left. "none": no key. Empty: the default (grey). Applies at the next start.
settings_notice: Changes apply on the next launch; existing 30 FPS timing defaults are unchanged.
setup_hint: Your own game files and console modules stay local. Nothing is downloaded or patched until you choose Play.
show_fps: Show FPS overlay at start (F10 toggles)
smaa: SMAA anti-aliasing (smooths edges; the HUD too)
title: The Last Guardian — PC
vram_hint: 6 GB card: 5600 · 8 GB: 7000 · 12 GB: 10500 · 16 GB: 14000 · 24 GB: 21500. This is video card memory (VRAM), not RAM; never above your card's VRAM.
metadata_needed: Names and hidden flags need decrypted trophy XML. Unknown entries are safely masked.
metadata_icons_only: Icons shown by request; names and hidden flags still need decrypted XML. Icons do not mean unlocked.
trophy_show_unknown_icons: Show unknown icons (may reveal hidden trophies)
photo_mode: Experimental photo mode (Windows EU 01.00, 60 FPS only; F8 / F9)
